title: RFC 15 addendum: intra-cluster L2 storm guard and egress-only forwarding

context.request: Analyze cluster broadcast storm concern and, if valid, codify in RFC.
context.user_concern: Node aware of cluster should not rebroadcast inside same cluster after L2 broadcast hit; should forward to external links only.

notes.summary: Normative §13 documents intra-cluster push suppression after local_broadcast ingress, egress-first relay to external/bridge peers, anti-entropy exceptions, metrics/alerts, default knob table. Cross-links slice 5 acceptance.
